newsitem.title: USA: Clintrials sees Q1 net falling to $0.04.
newsitem.headline: Clintrials sees Q1 net falling to $0.04.

text.p: ClinTrials Research Inc said on Tuesday it foresees its first quarter net income to be in the $27 million to $28 million range, with net per share of $0.04 - down from $0.08 for the first quarter of 1996.
ClinTrials attributed the decline to a decrease in backlog after three projects were canceled in February.

The company also said it is "discussing with a client the status" of another project, which if it runs into trouble could result in a first-quarter charge of up to $1.5 million, or $0.05, against earnings.
ClinTrials does contract research for the pharmaceutical, biotechnology and medical-device industries.
